sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: gliding (her move loop): she stands on the floating stage as it glides her along - her FEET STAY ON THE STAGE, she does not walk; her long hair and her skirt stream back (frames 1-3; frames 4-8 repeat them: 2, 1, 2, 3, 2)
sheets.weapons: HER HANDS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the white gloves raised, pointing or swept as the pale figure holds them. THE FLOATING STAGE stays under her feet in every frame (in the death it stays where the pale figure has it as she falls off), as big as in image 1. Only her: no music notes, no sound waves, no echoes, no glow; the stage's screen does not glow outward.
